title: national success
meaning_vi: thành công của quốc gia

examples.en: Many governments equate rapid GDP growth with national success, though this narrow view often overlooks social welfare.

title: unchecked economic growth
meaning_vi: tăng trưởng kinh tế không kiểm soát

examples.en: If left unregulated, unchecked economic growth can deplete natural resources faster than they can be replenished.

title: economic development
meaning_vi: sự phát triển kinh tế

examples.en: Investment in vocational training is essential to sustainable economic development in emerging nations.

title: infrastructure
meaning_vi: cơ sở hạ tầng

examples.en: Developing countries often struggle to fund the infrastructure needed to support long-term economic growth.

title: at the bottom of the economic ladder
term: at the bottom of the economic ladder
pronunciation: /æt ðə ˈbɒtəm əv ði ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk ˈlædə/
meaning_vi: ở tầng đáy của xã hội (về kinh tế)

examples.en: Families at the bottom of the economic ladder often lack access to quality education, perpetuating cycles of poverty.

title: Individuals living below the poverty line
term: Individuals living below the poverty line
meaning_vi: những người sống dưới mức nghèo khổ

examples.en: Governments should prioritize targeted assistance for individuals living below the poverty line rather than blanket subsidies.

title: focusing solely on income equality
meaning_vi: chỉ tập trung vào bình đẳng thu nhập

examples.en: Critics argue that focusing solely on income equality ignores other important measures of societal well-being.

title: income inequality
meaning_vi: bất bình đẳng thu nhập

examples.en: Progressive taxation is often proposed as a policy tool to narrow income inequality between the richest and poorest citizens.

title: elite
meaning_vi: tầng lớp tinh hoa, giới thượng lưu

examples.en: Critics argue that economic policy is too often shaped to benefit a small elite rather than the general population.

title: national income growth
meaning_vi: tăng trưởng thu nhập quốc dân

examples.en: Sustained national income growth allows a country to invest more heavily in public infrastructure and services.

title: cutting-edge healthcare
meaning_vi: dịch vụ y tế tiên tiến

examples.en: Wealthier economies can afford cutting-edge healthcare that significantly extends citizens' life expectancy.

title: living standards
meaning_vi: mức sống

examples.en: As economies expand, living standards typically improve through better housing, healthcare, and education.

title: geopolitical influence
meaning_vi: ảnh hưởng địa chính trị

examples.en: Economic power frequently translates into greater geopolitical influence on the world stage.

title: decline in productivity, innovation, and economic growth
term: decline in productivity, innovation, and economic growth
pronunciation: /dɪˈklaɪn ɪn ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən ənd ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk ɡrəʊθ/
meaning_vi: sự suy giảm năng suất, đổi mới và tăng trưởng kinh tế

examples.en: Heavy-handed regulation can trigger a decline in productivity, innovation, and economic growth across entire industries.

title: contribute to a more prosperous and content society overall
term: contribute to a more prosperous and content society overall
pronunciation: /kənˈtrɪbjuːt tə ə mɔː ˈprɒspərəs ənd kənˈtent səˈsaɪəti ˌəʊvərˈɔːl/
meaning_vi: góp phần tạo nên một xã hội thịnh vượng và mãn nguyện hơn

examples.en: Investing in public education can contribute to a more prosperous and content society overall.

title: increased prosperity for individuals
meaning_vi: sự thịnh vượng gia tăng cho cá nhân

examples.en: Rapid urban growth has brought increased prosperity for individuals but also greater social pressure to compete.

title: exert adverse effects
meaning_vi: gây ra những tác động bất lợi

examples.en: Prolonged economic downturns can exert adverse effects on mental health and family stability.

title: material gains
meaning_vi: lợi ích vật chất

examples.en: Beyond a certain income threshold, additional material gains contribute little to a person's overall happiness.

title: life satisfaction
meaning_vi: sự hài lòng với cuộc sống

examples.en: Studies consistently show that strong social relationships contribute more to life satisfaction than a higher salary.

title: overall well-being
meaning_vi: phúc lợi tổng thể

examples.en: Policymakers are increasingly measuring overall well-being rather than GDP alone as an indicator of national progress.

title: improve their social and economic standing
term: improve their social and economic standing
meaning_vi: cải thiện vị thế xã hội và kinh tế

examples.en: Access to microfinance has helped many rural entrepreneurs improve their social and economic standing.

title: straining familial bonds
meaning_vi: gây căng thẳng cho mối quan hệ gia đình

examples.en: Long working hours in modern economies are increasingly straining familial bonds.

title: eroding societal values
meaning_vi: làm xói mòn các giá trị xã hội

examples.en: Widening income inequality risks eroding societal values such as trust and solidarity.

title: exacerbating social tensions and disparities
meaning_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm căng thẳng và bất bình đẳng xã hội

examples.en: Rapid urbanisation without adequate planning risks exacerbating social tensions and disparities between rich and poor districts.

title: social connection
meaning_vi: sự kết nối xã hội

examples.en: Governments should invest in community centres that foster social connection, particularly among elderly residents living alone.

title: social unrest
meaning_vi: bất ổn xã hội

examples.en: Prolonged unemployment among young graduates can trigger social unrest if left unaddressed by policymakers.

title: social cohesion
meaning_vi: sự gắn kết xã hội

examples.en: Fair distribution of economic opportunities helps maintain social cohesion within increasingly diverse communities.

title: ceasing economic activities altogether
meaning_vi: ngừng hoàn toàn các hoạt động kinh tế

examples.en: Ceasing economic activities altogether is neither realistic nor desirable for developing economies seeking to reduce poverty.

title: boosting the country's economy
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy nền kinh tế đất nước

examples.en: Attracting foreign direct investment has proven highly effective in boosting the country's economy over the past decade.

title: completely eliminate the income gap
meaning_vi: xóa bỏ hoàn toàn khoảng cách thu nhập

examples.en: Attempting to completely eliminate the income gap through forced redistribution often proves economically counterproductive.

title: combating societal problems
meaning_vi: giải quyết các vấn đề xã hội

examples.en: Targeted economic policies have proven effective in combating societal problems such as homelessness and crime.

title: compelling arguments
meaning_vi: những lập luận thuyết phục

examples.en: There are compelling arguments on both sides regarding whether globalisation ultimately benefits developing economies.

title: domestically produced goods
meaning_vi: hàng hóa sản xuất trong nước

examples.en: Some governments impose tariffs to make domestically produced goods more competitive against imports.

title: globalized retail standardization
meaning_vi: tiêu chuẩn hóa bán lẻ toàn cầu

examples.en: Proponents of globalized retail standardization claim it guarantees the same shopping experience in any country.

title: sphere of influence
meaning_vi: phạm vi ảnh hưởng

examples.en: Multinational corporations have expanded their sphere of influence well beyond their home markets.

title: foreign direct investment
meaning_vi: đầu tư trực tiếp nước ngoài

examples.en: Many developing countries actively court foreign direct investment to accelerate industrialization.

title: cost efficiencies
meaning_vi: hiệu quả về chi phí

examples.en: Bulk purchasing allows large retail chains to achieve cost efficiencies that small shops simply cannot match.

title: erosion of regional culinary practices
meaning_vi: sự xói mòn các tập quán ẩm thực địa phương

examples.en: The spread of fast-food chains has contributed to the erosion of regional culinary practices in many towns.

title: fluidity of energy, knowledge, and capital markets
term: fluidity of energy, knowledge, and capital markets
pronunciation: /fluˈɪdəti əv ˈenədʒi ˈnɒlɪdʒ ənd ˈkæpɪtl ˈmɑːkɪts/
meaning_vi: tính lưu động của thị trường năng lượng, tri thức và vốn

examples.en: Economic integration has increased the fluidity of energy, knowledge, and capital markets across the continent.

title: gain economic advantages
meaning_vi: đạt được lợi thế kinh tế

examples.en: Countries that join large trading blocs typically gain economic advantages such as easier access to foreign markets.

title: grave socio-cultural costs
meaning_vi: những cái giá phải trả nghiêm trọng về mặt văn hóa xã hội

examples.en: Unchecked commercial expansion into heritage districts can carry grave socio-cultural costs for local communities.

title: homogenization of retail outlets and products
term: homogenization of retail outlets and products
meaning_vi: sự đồng nhất hóa các cửa hàng bán lẻ và sản phẩm

examples.en: Critics warn that the homogenization of retail outlets and products is making high streets around the world look identical.

title: impede the development
meaning_vi: cản trở sự phát triển

examples.en: Cheap imported goods can impede the development of local manufacturing sectors.

title: overreliance on foreign imports
meaning_vi: sự phụ thuộc quá mức vào hàng nhập khẩu

examples.en: An overreliance on foreign imports left the country's textile industry vulnerable during the supply chain crisis.

title: proliferation of standardized global products
meaning_vi: sự gia tăng nhanh chóng của các sản phẩm toàn cầu được tiêu chuẩn hóa

examples.en: The proliferation of standardized global products has made it harder for artisans to sell their unique wares.

title: symbiotic economic relationships
meaning_vi: mối quan hệ kinh tế cộng sinh

examples.en: Trade alliances often create symbiotic economic relationships in which every participating country benefits.

title: advantageous trade links
meaning_vi: liên kết thương mại có lợi

examples.en: Signing free trade agreements can create advantageous trade links that benefit exporters and consumers alike.

title: abolition of border controls
meaning_vi: việc bãi bỏ kiểm soát biên giới

examples.en: The abolition of border controls between member states has significantly simplified cross-border trade in the region.

title: facilitating free movement
meaning_vi: tạo điều kiện cho sự di chuyển tự do

examples.en: Facilitating free movement of goods and labour has allowed businesses to operate far more efficiently across borders.

title: foster economic development
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy phát triển kinh tế

examples.en: International trade agreements can foster economic development by opening new markets for domestic producers.

title: significantly facilitate foreign trade
meaning_vi: tạo điều kiện đáng kể cho thương mại quốc tế

examples.en: Modernised ports and reduced tariffs significantly facilitate foreign trade for exporting nations.

title: strategic partnerships
meaning_vi: quan hệ đối tác chiến lược

examples.en: Small nations often rely on strategic partnerships with larger economies to boost trade and technology transfer.

title: excel in business
meaning_vi: xuất sắc trong kinh doanh

examples.en: Strong negotiation skills often matter more than technical knowledge for those who wish to excel in business.

title: facilitated groundbreaking ideas
meaning_vi: tạo điều kiện cho những ý tưởng đột phá

examples.en: A culture of open communication has facilitated groundbreaking ideas within many successful technology start-ups.

title: one-time fees
meaning_vi: phí trả một lần

examples.en: Registering a new company usually involves one-time fees for licensing and legal documentation.

title: industrious, innovative, and driven
meaning_vi: chăm chỉ, sáng tạo và có động lực

examples.en: Successful entrepreneurs are typically industrious, innovative, and driven, willing to take risks others avoid.

title: fiercely competitive market
meaning_vi: thị trường cạnh tranh khốc liệt

examples.en: Start-ups in a fiercely competitive market must innovate constantly simply to survive.

title: artisanal crafts
meaning_vi: nghề thủ công truyền thống

examples.en: Tourists visiting the old quarter are drawn to shops selling artisanal crafts made by local families.

title: cut-throat
meaning_vi: khốc liệt (cạnh tranh gay gắt)

examples.en: The airline industry is notoriously cut-throat, with carriers slashing fares just to retain market share.

title: distinctive local offerings
meaning_vi: những sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ đặc trưng của địa phương

examples.en: Independent boutiques survive by promoting distinctive local offerings that big chains cannot replicate.

title: immediately accessible
meaning_vi: dễ dàng tiếp cận ngay lập tức

examples.en: A prime location near the highway means raw materials are immediately accessible to the factory.

title: bring perspectives
meaning_vi: mang lại góc nhìn mới

examples.en: A diverse workforce can bring perspectives that help a firm develop products suited to a wider range of customers.

title: contribute innovation and dynamism
meaning_vi: đóng góp sự đổi mới và năng động

examples.en: Younger staff members tend to contribute innovation and dynamism that keep a company relevant in a fast-moving market.

title: critical role of seasoned leaders
meaning_vi: vai trò quan trọng của những nhà lãnh đạo dày dạn kinh nghiệm

examples.en: During periods of economic uncertainty, the critical role of seasoned leaders becomes particularly evident.

title: extensive experience
meaning_vi: kinh nghiệm sâu rộng

examples.en: Managers with extensive experience are generally more skilled at negotiating favourable deals with suppliers.

title: heated topic of discussion
meaning_vi: chủ đề tranh luận sôi nổi

examples.en: Whether age or experience matters more in leadership remains a heated topic of discussion among business analysts.

title: possess certain qualities for leadership
meaning_vi: sở hữu những phẩm chất lãnh đạo nhất định

examples.en: Some young graduates possess certain qualities for leadership, such as confidence and adaptability, from an early age.

title: specialization
meaning_vi: sự chuyên môn hóa

examples.en: Increasing specialization within large corporations allows employees to become experts in narrow fields.

title: analyze large quantities of data
meaning_vi: phân tích khối lượng lớn dữ liệu

examples.en: Modern software allows even small firms to analyze large quantities of data and spot emerging trends.

title: financial capability
meaning_vi: khả năng tài chính

examples.en: Many start-ups overestimate their financial capability and run out of cash within the first year.

title: periodically
meaning_vi: theo định kỳ

examples.en: The finance team reviews the company's budget periodically to spot unnecessary spending.

title: recurring expenses
meaning_vi: chi phí định kỳ, chi phí lặp lại

examples.en: Rent and utility bills are recurring expenses that every small business must budget for each month.

title: accountability
meaning_vi: trách nhiệm giải trình

examples.en: Publishing an annual sustainability report increases a company's accountability to shareholders and the public.

title: agriculture industry
meaning_vi: ngành nông nghiệp

examples.en: The agriculture industry is under growing pressure to adapt its practices to unpredictable weather patterns.

title: cogent arguments
meaning_vi: những lập luận thuyết phục, có sức nặng

examples.en: Advocates of corporate social responsibility present cogent arguments about the long-term benefits of ethical business practices.

title: fossil fuels
meaning_vi: nhiên liệu hóa thạch

examples.en: Energy companies that rely heavily on fossil fuels are facing mounting pressure from environmental regulators.

title: natural disasters
meaning_vi: thiên tai

examples.en: Supply chains are increasingly disrupted by natural disasters such as floods and typhoons.

title: proceeds
meaning_vi: tiếp diễn, tiến triển

examples.en: As deforestation proceeds, timber firms are finding it harder to source raw materials sustainably.

title: sustainability
meaning_vi: tính bền vững

examples.en: Consumers increasingly favour brands that place sustainability at the core of their business model.

title: environmental sustainability
meaning_vi: tính bền vững của môi trường

examples.en: Policymakers increasingly recognize that environmental sustainability must accompany, not follow, economic expansion.

title: unchecked economic development
meaning_vi: phát triển kinh tế không kiểm soát

examples.en: Unchecked economic development in many industrializing regions has left rivers and forests severely degraded.

title: exponentially
meaning_vi: theo cấp số nhân, tăng vọt

examples.en: Demand for the app grew exponentially after it was featured on a popular tech blog.

title: compromising their core business operations
meaning_vi: gây tổn hại đến hoạt động kinh doanh cốt lõi

examples.en: A sudden expansion overseas risks compromising their core business operations at home.

title: exert negative effects
meaning_vi: gây ra những tác động tiêu cực

examples.en: Moving a factory far from its supplier network can exert negative effects on delivery times.

title: negatively impacts the businesses' survival
meaning_vi: tác động tiêu cực đến sự tồn tại của doanh nghiệp

examples.en: A sudden rise in rent negatively impacts the businesses' survival, especially for independent retailers.

title: struggle to allocate funds
meaning_vi: gặp khó khăn trong việc phân bổ ngân sách

examples.en: Family-run shops often struggle to allocate funds for staff training when profit margins are thin.

title: the unavailability of resources
meaning_vi: sự thiếu hụt nguồn lực

examples.en: Start-ups in remote areas often struggle with the unavailability of resources such as skilled labour.

title: operational challenge
meaning_vi: thách thức vận hành

examples.en: Experienced managers are usually better prepared to deal with an unexpected operational challenge than their younger counterparts.

title: succeed in managerial positions
meaning_vi: thành công ở vị trí quản lý

examples.en: Formal training can help ambitious employees succeed in managerial positions much earlier in their careers.

title: excel in innovation
meaning_vi: xuất sắc trong đổi mới sáng tạo

examples.en: Small technology firms often excel in innovation precisely because they are not constrained by rigid bureaucracy.

title: entangled in
meaning_vi: vướng bận, mắc kẹt vào

examples.en: Employees who become entangled in office politics often lose focus on their actual responsibilities.

title: valuing personal gain
meaning_vi: coi trọng lợi ích cá nhân

examples.en: Corporate cultures that prioritize valuing personal gain over teamwork often struggle to retain talent.

title: exceptionally high salaries
meaning_vi: mức lương cực kỳ cao

examples.en: Some business leaders receive exceptionally high salaries that bear little relation to their companies' actual performance.

title: jeopardizes their financial stability
meaning_vi: đe dọa sự ổn định tài chính

examples.en: Taking on excessive debt to fund rapid growth often jeopardizes their financial stability in the long run.

title: pay premiums
meaning_vi: trả mức phí cao hơn

examples.en: Companies with poor safety records are forced to pay premiums for their insurance coverage.

title: boosted their reputation
meaning_vi: nâng cao danh tiếng

examples.en: Companies that responded generously during the crisis boosted their reputation among socially conscious customers.

title: challenging and slower progress in environmental initiatives
term: challenging and slower progress in environmental initiatives
pronunciation: /ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ənd ˈsləʊə ˈprəʊɡres ɪn ɪnˌvaɪərənˈmentl ɪˈnɪʃətɪvz/
meaning_vi: tiến trình chậm hơn và khó khăn hơn trong các sáng kiến môi trường

examples.en: Without international cooperation, there would be challenging and slower progress in environmental initiatives across the globe.

title: effects of climate change
meaning_vi: tác động của biến đổi khí hậu

examples.en: Insurance companies are already adjusting their premiums to reflect the effects of climate change on property risk.

title: exaggeration
meaning_vi: sự phóng đại

examples.en: To claim that every traditional retailer will vanish within a decade is surely an exaggeration.

title: exploit natural resources
meaning_vi: khai thác tài nguyên thiên nhiên

examples.en: Mining corporations that exploit natural resources without proper regulation often cause lasting environmental damage.

title: face challenges
meaning_vi: đối mặt với thách thức

examples.en: Coastal fishing businesses face challenges as rising sea temperatures reduce fish stocks.

title: flourish
meaning_vi: phát triển mạnh, thịnh vượng

examples.en: Companies that embrace remote work have continued to flourish even amid rising office costs.

title: hardships
meaning_vi: khó khăn, gian khổ

examples.en: Small exporters endured severe hardships when international shipping costs tripled overnight.

title: resource depletion
meaning_vi: sự cạn kiệt tài nguyên

examples.en: Investors are now factoring resource depletion into their long-term risk assessments of mining firms.

title: social evils
meaning_vi: tệ nạn xã hội

examples.en: Campaigners argue that businesses have a duty to help tackle social evils such as poverty and pollution.

title: comes at a steep environmental cost
term: comes at a steep environmental cost
meaning_vi: phải trả giá đắt về môi trường

examples.en: Rapid industrial expansion frequently comes at a steep environmental cost that future generations must bear.

title: emit significant amounts of greenhouse gasses
term: emit significant amounts of greenhouse gasses
meaning_vi: thải ra lượng lớn khí nhà kính

examples.en: Coal-fired power plants continue to emit significant amounts of greenhouse gasses despite global climate commitments.

title: untreated industrial waste
meaning_vi: chất thải công nghiệp chưa qua xử lý

examples.en: Factories that dump untreated industrial waste into waterways pose serious risks to public health.

title: detrimental impact of economic growth
meaning_vi: tác động bất lợi của tăng trưởng kinh tế

examples.en: Economists are increasingly studying the detrimental impact of economic growth on biodiversity and natural habitats.

title: contributor to environmental degradation
meaning_vi: tác nhân gây suy thoái môi trường

examples.en: Fast fashion has become a major contributor to environmental degradation through textile waste and chemical runoff.

title: environmental degradation
meaning_vi: sự suy thoái môi trường

examples.en: Rapid deforestation for agriculture is a leading cause of environmental degradation in tropical regions.

title: exacts a heavy toll on
meaning_vi: gây thiệt hại nặng nề cho

examples.en: The relentless pursuit of profit often exacts a heavy toll on employees' mental health and work-life balance.

title: sustain the conglomerate's growth and dominance
term: sustain the conglomerate's growth and dominance
meaning_vi: duy trì sự tăng trưởng và vị thế thống trị của tập đoàn

examples.en: Continuous investment in research has helped sustain the conglomerate's growth and dominance for decades.

title: anticipate market risks
meaning_vi: dự đoán trước rủi ro thị trường

examples.en: Seasoned executives are often able to anticipate market risks well before they become apparent to competitors.

title: bring out the best in people
term: bring out the best in people
meaning_vi: khơi dậy những điều tốt nhất ở con người

examples.en: A good manager knows how to bring out the best in people, even during stressful projects.

title: demonstrate emotional maturity
meaning_vi: thể hiện sự trưởng thành về cảm xúc

examples.en: Effective leaders must demonstrate emotional maturity when handling conflicts between employees.

title: handling high-pressure situations
meaning_vi: xử lý các tình huống áp lực cao

examples.en: Years of experience give older managers a distinct advantage when it comes to handling high-pressure situations.

title: leveraged his deep industry knowledge
meaning_vi: tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về ngành

examples.en: The chief executive leveraged his deep industry knowledge to steer the firm safely through the recession.

title: maintain rational guidance
meaning_vi: duy trì sự chỉ dẫn hợp lý

examples.en: A good manager must maintain rational guidance even when the company is facing a serious financial crisis.

title: make informed decisions
meaning_vi: đưa ra quyết định sáng suốt

examples.en: Access to accurate data allows executives to make informed decisions rather than relying purely on intuition.

title: managing relationships and communicating with people
term: managing relationships and communicating with people
meaning_vi: quản lý các mối quan hệ và giao tiếp với con người

examples.en: Effective leadership depends heavily on managing relationships and communicating with people across departments.

title: preventing strategic mistakes
meaning_vi: ngăn ngừa sai lầm chiến lược

examples.en: Thorough market research plays a crucial role in preventing strategic mistakes before a product is launched.

title: revamping a strategy
meaning_vi: cải tổ một chiến lược

examples.en: Revamping a strategy in response to changing customer preferences can help a business stay competitive.

title: stay one step ahead of their opponents
term: stay one step ahead of their opponents
pronunciation: /steɪ wʌn step əˈhed əv ðeər əˈpəʊnənts/
meaning_vi: luôn đi trước đối thủ một bước

examples.en: Constant innovation helps tech companies stay one step ahead of their opponents in a crowded market.

title: drive innovation
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy đổi mới sáng tạo

examples.en: Young employees often drive innovation within a company because they are less resistant to change.

title: drive innovation and adapt to trends
term: drive innovation and adapt to trends
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy đổi mới và thích ứng với xu hướng

examples.en: Start-ups founded by young entrepreneurs often drive innovation and adapt to trends faster than established corporations.

title: boosting overall revenue
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy tổng doanh thu

examples.en: Expanding into overseas markets is one of the most effective ways of boosting overall revenue.

title: biodegradable cosmetics
meaning_vi: mỹ phẩm có thể phân hủy sinh học

examples.en: A growing number of start-ups specialise in biodegradable cosmetics packaged in compostable containers.

title: collective efforts
meaning_vi: những nỗ lực tập thể

examples.en: The collective efforts of multinational corporations are essential if global carbon emissions are to be reduced substantially.

title: corporate social responsibility initiatives
meaning_vi: các sáng kiến trách nhiệm xã hội doanh nghiệp

examples.en: The bank launched several corporate social responsibility initiatives, including free financial literacy workshops for low-income families.

title: enhance their public image
meaning_vi: nâng cao hình ảnh công chúng

examples.en: Many technology giants sponsor charitable projects to enhance their public image among consumers.

title: environmentally friendly products
meaning_vi: sản phẩm thân thiện với môi trường

examples.en: Retailers that stock environmentally friendly products are attracting a loyal base of younger consumers.

title: feasible initiatives
meaning_vi: những sáng kiến khả thi

examples.en: Governments should work with businesses to design feasible initiatives that reduce environmental damage without harming profits.

title: fulfill their corporate social responsibility
meaning_vi: thực hiện trách nhiệm xã hội của doanh nghiệp

examples.en: Large corporations are increasingly expected to fulfill their corporate social responsibility by reducing waste and pollution.

title: pledged to achieve carbon neutrality
meaning_vi: cam kết đạt được trung hòa carbon

examples.en: Many leading corporations have pledged to achieve carbon neutrality within the next two decades.

title: portable wooden utensils packs
meaning_vi: bộ dụng cụ gỗ tiện mang theo

examples.en: Eco-conscious travellers now carry portable wooden utensils packs instead of single-use plastic cutlery.

title: reached net-zero emissions
meaning_vi: đạt được mức phát thải ròng bằng không

examples.en: A handful of pioneering companies have already reached net-zero emissions ahead of government deadlines.

title: society's betterment
meaning_vi: sự tiến bộ, cải thiện của xã hội

examples.en: The foundation reinvests a portion of its profits into projects aimed at society's betterment.

title: undertake such initiatives
meaning_vi: thực hiện những sáng kiến như vậy

examples.en: Only firms with substantial reserves are able to undertake such initiatives without risking their cash flow.

title: sustainable practices
meaning_vi: các thực hành bền vững

examples.en: Firms that adopt sustainable practices tend to build stronger long-term reputations among environmentally conscious consumers.

title: pursue economic growth in an environmentally sustainable manner
term: pursue economic growth in an environmentally sustainable manner
pronunciation: /pəˈsjuː ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk ɡrəʊθ ɪn ən ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmentəli səˈsteɪnəbəl ˈmænə/
meaning_vi: theo đuổi tăng trưởng kinh tế theo hướng bền vững với môi trường

examples.en: Rather than halting industrial expansion, nations should pursue economic growth in an environmentally sustainable manner.

title: making economic activities more environmentally sustainable
term: making economic activities more environmentally sustainable
meaning_vi: làm cho các hoạt động kinh tế bền vững hơn với môi trường

examples.en: Adopting circular production models is one practical way of making economic activities more environmentally sustainable.

title: emit minimal pollutants
meaning_vi: thải ra rất ít chất gây ô nhiễm

examples.en: Electric vehicles emit minimal pollutants compared with traditional petrol-powered cars.

title: cleaner energy alternatives
meaning_vi: các nguồn năng lượng thay thế sạch hơn

examples.en: Governments are subsidizing cleaner energy alternatives to hasten the transition away from fossil fuels.

title: promoting eco-friendly policies and practices
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy các chính sách và thực hành thân thiện với môi trường

examples.en: Many corporations are now promoting eco-friendly policies and practices to attract environmentally minded customers.

title: analyse large quantities of data
meaning_vi: phân tích khối lượng lớn dữ liệu

examples.en: Modern recruiters look for candidates who can analyse large quantities of data to guide business decisions.

title: assist in logistics or administrative tasks
term: assist in logistics or administrative tasks
meaning_vi: hỗ trợ các công việc hậu cần hoặc hành chính

examples.en: Interns are usually hired to assist in logistics or administrative tasks during peak seasons.

title: command natural respect from employees
meaning_vi: nhận được sự tôn trọng tự nhiên từ nhân viên

examples.en: Managers who command natural respect from employees usually find it easier to implement organisational change.

title: demonstrates the ability to think critically
term: demonstrates the ability to think critically
meaning_vi: thể hiện khả năng tư duy phản biện

examples.en: A well-argued business proposal demonstrates the ability to think critically under pressure.

title: mathematical ability
meaning_vi: khả năng toán học

examples.en: Strong mathematical ability is highly valued in roles that involve budgeting and forecasting.

title: proficiency in maths
meaning_vi: sự thành thạo về toán học

examples.en: Candidates with proficiency in maths often have an advantage when applying for finance positions.

title: seniority
meaning_vi: thâm niên

examples.en: Promotions in many traditional companies are still awarded largely on the basis of seniority rather than performance.

title: to be knowledgeable in maths
meaning_vi: am hiểu về toán học

examples.en: Accountants need to be knowledgeable in maths to interpret complex financial statements accurately.

title: to be well versed in mathematics
term: to be well versed in mathematics
meaning_vi: thông thạo về toán học

examples.en: Data analysts need to be well versed in mathematics to build reliable forecasting models.

title: vital to the success of
meaning_vi: thiết yếu đối với sự thành công của

examples.en: Strong numerical skills are vital to the success of anyone working in financial planning.

title: vital to the success of an individual
term: vital to the success of an individual
pronunciation: /ˈvaɪtl tə ðə səkˈses əv ən ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl/
meaning_vi: thiết yếu đối với thành công của một cá nhân

examples.en: Adaptability is widely considered vital to the success of an individual in a fast-changing job market.

title: engrossed in tasks
meaning_vi: mải mê với công việc

examples.en: Parents who are constantly engrossed in tasks on their phones risk neglecting their children's emotional needs.

title: inadequacies of well-trained employees
meaning_vi: sự thiếu hụt nhân viên được đào tạo bài bản

examples.en: Rural branches frequently face inadequacies of well-trained employees compared with their urban counterparts.

title: lack of experience and maturity
meaning_vi: thiếu kinh nghiệm và sự chín chắn

examples.en: Critics argue that a lack of experience and maturity can lead young managers to make impulsive business decisions.

title: overall job satisfaction
meaning_vi: mức độ hài lòng chung với công việc

examples.en: Flexible working hours have been shown to boost overall job satisfaction among office staff.

title: discourage ambition and stifle motivation
meaning_vi: làm nản lòng tham vọng và kìm hãm động lực

examples.en: Excessive taxation on high earners may discourage ambition and stifle motivation across the workforce.

title: lose the incentive to work hard
term: lose the incentive to work hard
meaning_vi: mất động lực làm việc chăm chỉ

examples.en: When wages fail to reflect effort, workers may lose the incentive to work hard.

title: increase their earning potential
meaning_vi: tăng tiềm năng thu nhập

examples.en: Acquiring new technical skills is one of the most reliable ways for workers to increase their earning potential.

title: secure stable jobs and earn sufficient income
term: secure stable jobs and earn sufficient income
pronunciation: /sɪˈkjʊə ˈsteɪbəl dʒɒbz ənd ɜːn səˈfɪʃənt ˈɪŋkʌm/
meaning_vi: có việc làm ổn định và thu nhập đủ sống

examples.en: Government-backed job schemes help citizens secure stable jobs and earn sufficient income to support their families.

title: sacrificing precious time
meaning_vi: hy sinh thời gian quý báu

examples.en: Ambitious professionals frequently end up sacrificing precious time with family in pursuit of career success.

title: a sense of purpose
meaning_vi: cảm giác có mục đích sống

examples.en: Meaningful employment gives workers a sense of purpose that no amount of financial compensation can fully replace.

title: sustaining staff morale
meaning_vi: duy trì tinh thần làm việc của nhân viên

examples.en: Regular recognition schemes are essential for sustaining staff morale during periods of organisational change.

title: implement vocational training programs
meaning_vi: triển khai các chương trình đào tạo nghề

examples.en: To address youth unemployment, the government should implement vocational training programs tailored to labour-market needs.

title: career development initiatives
meaning_vi: sáng kiến phát triển nghề nghiệp

examples.en: Universities are increasingly partnering with businesses to offer career development initiatives to graduates.

title: company's image and market position
meaning_vi: hình ảnh và vị thế thị trường của công ty

examples.en: A single product failure can seriously damage a company's image and market position within its industry.

title: consumption behaviors
meaning_vi: hành vi tiêu dùng

examples.en: The pandemic permanently altered consumption behaviors, pushing more shoppers toward online platforms.

title: exceptionally
meaning_vi: đặc biệt, vô cùng

examples.en: Modern advertising campaigns can reach an exceptionally wide audience within a matter of hours.

title: high-end clothes stores
meaning_vi: cửa hàng quần áo cao cấp

examples.en: High-end clothes stores tend to cluster in wealthy districts where footfall from affluent shoppers is highest.

title: own a one-of-a-kind and sought-after product
term: own a one-of-a-kind and sought-after product
pronunciation: /əʊn ə ˌwʌn əv ə ˈkaɪnd ənd ˈsɔːt ˌɑːftə ˈprɒdʌkt/
meaning_vi: sở hữu một sản phẩm độc nhất vô nhị và được săn đón

examples.en: Luxury brands thrive because they own a one-of-a-kind and sought-after product that few competitors can replicate.

title: target market
meaning_vi: thị trường mục tiêu

examples.en: Before launching the app, the developers spent months researching their target market's spending habits.

title: tempting
meaning_vi: hấp dẫn, có sức cám dỗ

examples.en: The discount looked so tempting that customers queued outside the store before it even opened.

title: luxury goods
meaning_vi: hàng hóa xa xỉ

examples.en: Demand for luxury goods tends to rise sharply as disposable income among the wealthy increases.

title: builds greater brand recognition
meaning_vi: xây dựng mức độ nhận diện thương hiệu cao hơn

examples.en: Sponsoring major sporting events builds greater brand recognition than ordinary television commercials.

title: cultivates a sense of familiarity
meaning_vi: tạo ra cảm giác quen thuộc

examples.en: Seeing the same coffee chain in every airport cultivates a sense of familiarity for frequent travelers.

title: fear of missing out
meaning_vi: nỗi sợ bỏ lỡ

examples.en: Advertisers deliberately exploit consumers' fear of missing out to drive impulsive purchases during flash sales.

title: is prompted to buy the goods out of curiosity
term: is prompted to buy the goods out of curiosity
pronunciation: /ɪz ˈprɒmptɪd tə baɪ ðə gʊdz aʊt ɒv ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti/
meaning_vi: bị thôi thúc mua hàng vì tò mò

examples.en: When a limited-edition item appears in a shop window, a passer-by is often prompted to buy the goods out of curiosity.

title: product availability and affordability
meaning_vi: sự sẵn có và khả năng chi trả của sản phẩm

examples.en: Online marketplaces have dramatically improved product availability and affordability for rural consumers.

title: translates into sustained, high-volume sales
meaning_vi: chuyển hóa thành doanh số bán hàng lớn và bền vững

examples.en: Strong brand loyalty often translates into sustained, high-volume sales, even when competitors offer lower prices.

title: unparalleled audience reach
meaning_vi: khả năng tiếp cận khán giả vô song

examples.en: Television advertising offers companies unparalleled audience reach, allowing a single campaign to influence millions of potential customers overnight.

title: extravagant lifestyles
meaning_vi: lối sống xa hoa

examples.en: Newfound wealth has led some people to adopt extravagant lifestyles that strain their long-term savings.

title: rise in materialism
meaning_vi: sự gia tăng của chủ nghĩa vật chất

examples.en: Economic prosperity has fuelled a rise in materialism, particularly among younger urban consumers.

title: acquiring material possessions
meaning_vi: tích lũy của cải vật chất

examples.en: Advertising encourages people to measure their self-worth by acquiring material possessions.

title: self-centered
meaning_vi: vị kỷ, chỉ nghĩ đến bản thân

examples.en: A culture that rewards individual achievement can make people more self-centered over time.

title: excessive consumerism
meaning_vi: chủ nghĩa tiêu dùng quá mức

examples.en: Excessive consumerism drives households into debt while generating enormous amounts of waste.

title: boost their profit
meaning_vi: tăng lợi nhuận

examples.en: Many firms cut unnecessary overheads in order to boost their profit during economic downturns.

title: carefully orchestrated media coverage
meaning_vi: sự đưa tin trên truyền thông được dàn dựng cẩn thận

examples.en: Carefully orchestrated media coverage can transform a small start-up into a household name almost overnight.

title: come up with innovative ways
meaning_vi: nghĩ ra những cách sáng tạo

examples.en: Start-up founders must constantly come up with innovative ways to stand out in a saturated market.

title: consistent quality standards
meaning_vi: tiêu chuẩn chất lượng nhất quán

examples.en: International franchises are valued by customers for maintaining consistent quality standards in every branch.

title: create powerful incentives
meaning_vi: tạo ra những động lực mạnh mẽ

examples.en: Loyalty programmes create powerful incentives for customers to remain with the same retailer for years.

title: creates its own segment
meaning_vi: tạo ra phân khúc thị trường riêng

examples.en: By pioneering plant-based snacks, the company creates its own segment rather than competing head-on with rivals.

title: elevate product awareness
meaning_vi: nâng cao nhận thức về sản phẩm

examples.en: Social media influencers are frequently hired to elevate product awareness among younger consumers.

title: mold brand desirability
meaning_vi: định hình sức hấp dẫn của thương hiệu

examples.en: Celebrity endorsements are frequently used to mold brand desirability among impressionable teenagers.

title: offer promotions
meaning_vi: đưa ra các chương trình khuyến mãi

examples.en: Supermarkets regularly offer promotions on seasonal produce to clear excess stock quickly.

title: shape consumer demand
meaning_vi: định hình nhu cầu tiêu dùng

examples.en: Persistent advertising can shape consumer demand to such an extent that people buy products they do not genuinely need.

title: take on different branding schemes
meaning_vi: áp dụng các chiến lược xây dựng thương hiệu khác nhau

examples.en: As competition intensifies, retailers often take on different branding schemes to appeal to younger shoppers.

title: realm of government and public institutions
term: realm of government and public institutions
meaning_vi: lĩnh vực của chính phủ và các cơ quan công

examples.en: Some critics argue that welfare provision should remain firmly within the realm of government and public institutions.

title: public revenues
meaning_vi: nguồn thu ngân sách nhà nước

examples.en: Rising public revenues from taxation enable governments to fund large-scale education reforms.

title: democratic principles
meaning_vi: các nguyên tắc dân chủ

examples.en: Allowing corporate wealth to dictate policy decisions ultimately undermines democratic principles and public accountability.

title: negative social consequences
meaning_vi: hậu quả tiêu cực về mặt xã hội

examples.en: Unregulated gambling advertising can have negative social consequences, particularly among vulnerable young people.

title: foster corruption
meaning_vi: nuôi dưỡng/tạo điều kiện cho tham nhũng

examples.en: A lack of transparency in public procurement can foster corruption and erode citizens' trust in government.

title: be compelled to
meaning_vi: bị buộc phải

examples.en: Manufacturers may be compelled to disclose their carbon emissions under new environmental legislation.

title: be mandatory for
meaning_vi: là bắt buộc đối với

examples.en: Some campaigners believe that ethical sourcing should be mandatory for all large retailers.

title: enhancing city citizens' living standards
meaning_vi: nâng cao mức sống của cư dân thành phố

examples.en: Investment in public transport plays a key role in enhancing city citizens' living standards.

title: lessening income inequality
meaning_vi: giảm bất bình đẳng thu nhập

examples.en: Creating jobs in rural provinces is an effective strategy for lessening income inequality between regions.

title: reducing the number of over-crowding related issues
term: reducing the number of over-crowding related issues
pronunciation: /rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ðə ˈnʌmbər əv ˌəʊvəˈkraʊdɪŋ rɪˈleɪtɪd ˈɪʃuːz/
meaning_vi: giảm thiểu các vấn đề liên quan đến quá tải dân số

examples.en: Encouraging firms to open branches outside the capital is one way of reducing the number of over-crowding related issues.

title: tax reliefs on imports and exports
term: tax reliefs on imports and exports
meaning_vi: ưu đãi thuế đối với hàng nhập khẩu và xuất khẩu

examples.en: Offering tax reliefs on imports and exports can encourage smaller firms to expand into international markets.

title: the relocation of enterprises to the suburbs
term: the relocation of enterprises to the suburbs
pronunciation: /ðə ˌriːləʊˈkeɪʃn əv ˈentəpraɪzɪz tə ðə ˈsʌbɜːbz/
meaning_vi: việc di dời doanh nghiệp ra ngoại ô

examples.en: The relocation of enterprises to the suburbs has eased traffic congestion in the city centre.

title: equitable welfare policies
meaning_vi: chính sách phúc lợi công bằng

examples.en: Governments should design equitable welfare policies to ensure that economic gains benefit all social groups, not just the wealthy.

title: enforce stricter regulations
meaning_vi: thực thi các quy định nghiêm ngặt hơn

examples.en: Regulators should enforce stricter regulations on heavy industries to curb air and water pollution.

title: impose limits
meaning_vi: áp đặt giới hạn

examples.en: Some economists believe governments should impose limits on executive pay to reduce excessive corporate inequality.

title: stimulating various sectors
meaning_vi: kích thích nhiều lĩnh vực khác nhau

examples.en: Government infrastructure spending plays a key role in stimulating various sectors, from construction to manufacturing.
